reference.title: Scenario 3 — Hyperlink with non-descriptive display text
reference.shortdesc: Consider a Normal paragraph that contains a hyperlink where the author has used non-descriptive display

section.p: Consider a Normal paragraph that contains a hyperlink where the author has used non-descriptive display text such as "click here", "here", or a bare URL as the visible label, rather than a phrase that describes the destination.

row.entry: Click [hyperlink: https://example.com/docs │ here] for the full API reference.

entry.codeblock: See click here for the full API reference.

section.p: Result:The hyperlink is converted correctly into a DITA <xref> element with display text preserved.
section.note: Use descriptive hyperlink text such as "API reference" or "release notes" instead of "click here" or raw URLs.
